check: EventBus worker process recovery and durable event completion across disposable PostgreSQL stop/start
limitations: Only the event, durable-handler, and notification table migrations were replayed in the disposable database; the full ordered schema ledger was not applied.
Synthetic events had no matching handlers, so real EventBus lease and completion SQL ran without invoking application handlers.
Notification processing used the real outbox query against an empty queue; no external delivery provider was configured.
The PostgreSQL container had no volume and was bound only to loopback.
